title: Happy Andrada brings 25 years of fashion across generations on one runway
summary: Happy Andrada celebrated her 25th anniversary at BGC Arts Center with designs spanning her career, a new collection featuring Philippine weaves, and performances by The CompanY and Anima Tierra.
